title: Concept: SNS topic ARN in a response
description: An SNS topic ARN with its account and region in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The ARN identifies the fan-out channel the App publishes to, and a permissive topic policy then allows anyone who knows the ARN to publish forged events.
applicability: Deployments that render an SNS topic ARN with its account and region into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The ARN identifies the fan-out channel the App publishes to, and a permissive topic policy then allows anyone who knows the ARN to publish forged events.
